summary: This API needs two credentials, so both must have a config-file home: the OMDb key resolves from config.toml's omdb_api_key or OMDB_API_KEY (env wins), never from os.Getenv alone.
reason: The generated config schema models a single credential (api_key), so a second-API key has no persistent slot and the enrichment call sites read the environment directly. A regen that restores env-only OMDb resolution reintroduces the split: one key stored by auth set-token, the other only settable per-shell and invisible to auth status and doctor.
validated_outcome: go build/vet/test pass; an OMDb key supplied via OMDB_API_KEY is never marshaled into config.toml by an unrelated save (covered by TestOmdbEnvNeverWrittenToConfigFile) because the env value is held in an unexported field.
